claims.claim: Infleqtion announced on September 24 that Sqale achieved 30 entangled logical qubits using 80 physical qubits, meeting its stated 2026 roadmap milestone. This reduces the specific milestone uncertainty preserved in prior Beta evidence, but does not by itself establish customer economic advantage or durable commercial utilization.

The September 29 Riverlane announcement is an MOU to explore integration of real-time quantum error correction with Infleqtion's neutral-atom stack. It directly targets a successor bottleneck identified by Beta, but an exploratory MOU is not evidence that integrated fault-tolerant performance or commercial economics have been achieved.

The milestone improves technical execution evidence while leaving Alpha's downside treatment centered on conversion risk: verified logical-qubit progress must still translate into repeatable customer workloads, economics and revenue before technical progress can be treated as self-validating commercial de-risking.

risks.risk: Technical milestone attainment can precede repeatable customer economic advantage and scalable commercial utilization.
The Riverlane relationship is currently an exploratory MOU; integration performance and commercial impact remain unverified.

contradictions.contradiction: The previously open 30-logical-qubit roadmap milestone is now issuer-reported as achieved, while the broader economic-utility uncertainty remains unresolved.
contradictions.disposition: prior technical unknown narrowed; preserve commercial-conversion uncertainty rather than treating the milestone as full thesis validation

unknowns.unknown: Independent technical replication or third-party validation of the 30-logical-qubit result.
Customer workload economics and revenue contribution attributable to the new logical-qubit capability.
Whether Riverlane integration progresses from MOU to measured real-time error-correction performance on Sqale.

lineage.note: Bounded assist evidence; does not replace Beta-owned structural-causal or adversarial-red-team perspectives and does not set Alpha numeric risk/score.
